a bus or train that stops at all places on the route （沿线每站都停的）公共汽车，火车

ex.s: While taking a 20-hour train ride along the edge of the Taklimakan Desert in northwestern China, I had the kind of humbling, educational, and above all else, wonderful   41   with a local that all travelers long for.
ex.t: 在中国西北部塔克拉玛干沙漠边缘乘坐20小时火车的途中，我与一位当地人进行了一次令人谦卑、富有教育意义，最重要的是美妙的41交谈，这是所有旅行者都渴望的。

ex.s: It’s also thought that these places could help reduce the risk of flooding, remove carbon from the atmosphere and fight climate change, as well as improving the mental health of those living locally.
ex.t: 人们还认为这些地方可以帮助减少洪水风险、从大气中去除碳、应对气候变化，以及改善当地居民的心理健康。
